research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: Si diamond 2-atom primitive cell
purpose: Standard L1 DFT smoke fixture — diamond Si is the most cited semiconductor benchmark; convergence delta is the canonical L1 publication-grade gate.

sources.locator: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics 90th ed., Si crystallographic data

notes: Conventional cubic a = 5.4307 Å; primitive 2-atom rhombohedral representation. Two Si atoms at (0,0,0) and (1/4,1/4,1/4) of conventional. Space group Fd-3m (#227).
